title: Nation Wants to Guess with Khamba | Finale ft. @kaneezsurka007 @sonofabish @rohanjoshi8016
summary: Gursimran Khamba hosts the finale with Kaneez Surka, Abish Mathew, and Rohan Joshi, mixing quiz rounds with roasts, callbacks, and Hinglish banter. The questions range from odd news stories and pop culture to blindfolded celebrity guessing, while audience member Jeet wins a prize in the audience round. Rohan builds a commanding lead, correctly identifies Stephen Hawking, and finishes with 990 points. After the finale and prize presentation, a 2.5 BHK callback leads into the closing credits and a Season 2 announcement.
